COUNTDOWN_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, apply [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to 150% of the original amount ({Amount}) to a random enemy and one third of the original amount to yourself. Round down.
OBLIVION_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever the applier plays a card this turn, apply [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to 150% of the original amount ({Amount}) to this enemy and one third of the original amount to the applier. Round down.
OBLIVION_POWER.remoteDescription: Whenever [gold]{ApplierName}[/gold] plays a card this turn, apply [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to 150% of the original amount ({Amount}) to this enemy and one third of the original amount to the applier. Round down.
REAPER_FORM_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever your Attacks deal damage, the original [gold]Doom[/gold] is damage dealt times {Amount}. Apply 150% of that amount to the target and one third to yourself. Round down.
NEUROSURGE_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, apply [gold]Doom[/gold] equal to 150% of the original amount ({Amount}) to yourself, then apply one third of the original amount to yourself again. Round down.
UNDERWORLD_POWER.smartDescription: This turn, whenever other players' Attacks or their pets' Attacks deal damage, the original [gold]Doom[/gold] is damage dealt times {Amount}. Apply 150% of that amount to the target and one third to yourself. Round down.
